title: SWU glossary
description: Schema for swu-glossary.json: one entry per distinct value of each card facet, read by the export script to build per-facet indexes. Entries inside a facet are sorted by value in code point order.

facets.description: The facets, each an array of value entries.

trait.description: Every trait carried by a printing.

type.description: Every card type, plus Leader Unit (the type2 value).

expansion.description: Every expansion, keyed by its code.

token.description: Every token, keyed by the token card's title.

Facet.description: Entries for one facet, sorted by value in code point order.

Entry.description: One facet value with its meaning.

value.description: The value exactly as it appears in the data.

definition.description: What the value means in play, in plain sentences.

strategicValue.description: What a collector, player or the sorter decides with it.

source.description: Where the meaning comes from: a full URL, a rules digest section, or card text.

inScope.description: True when the value appears in the delivered LLM package scope: cards with a printing in Jump to Lightspeed or later (JTL, LOF, SEC, LAW, ASH, HMW and their Weekly Play sets). For aspect, trait, keyword, type, arena and token the test is card-level (any printing of a card that has an in-scope printing). For expansion, variant and rarity it is printing-level (the value appears on a printing that is itself in an in-scope set).
